name: Waterfall / Bridge
summary: Bridge from an opening to a closing total through signed steps — EBITDA bridge, EV-to-equity bridge, budget variance walk.
summary_zh: 从期初总额经过各项正负变动走到期末总额的桥接图：EBITDA 桥、企业价值到股权价值桥、预算差异分析。
description_zh: 每一行是一步：kind 为 total / subtotal 的柱子从 0 起画，delta 柱子从累计值处浮动，正向变动用 pos 色、负向用 neg 色、合计用主色，柱间以细连接线衔接，标签带 +/− 号。适用于解释两个数之间的差异由哪些驱动因素构成（如 FY25A→FY26E EBITDA 的量、价、成本、并购、汇率贡献，或 EV 扣减净债务、少数股东权益得到股权价值）。没有 kind 字段时自动把首尾两行当作合计；合计值缺失时按累计值计算；变动相对合计很小时可开启 axisBreak 断轴放大变动。
best_for: EBITDA / revenue / net income bridges between two periods
Enterprise value to equity value bridge
Sources of value creation (LBO returns attribution)
avoid_when: More than ~15 steps (aggregate small drivers into 'Other')
Steps that are not additive (use a bar chart)
Time series of levels (use line / bar)

value.desc: Signed change for delta steps; absolute level for total / subtotal steps (null = computed from the walk)

kind.desc: total | subtotal | delta (also accepts start / end). Without it, totals are inferred via inferTotals

category.desc: Driver group (Organic / Cost / M&A / FX) used by colorBy: 'category' and shown in the tooltip

orientation.desc: vertical | horizontal (horizontal suits long step names)

inferTotals.desc: Which rows are totals when a row has no kind: 'auto' (first and last when the kind field is absent) | 'first' | 'last' | 'both' | false

endTotal.desc: Label of a computed closing total appended after the last row (e.g. 'FY26E EBITDA')

colorBy.desc: sign (pos / neg colours) | category (deltas coloured by the category channel, with legend)

invert.desc: Increases are unfavourable (cost walks): swap the pos / neg colours

connectors.desc: Connector lines between bars: true | 'dashed' | false

labels.desc: Value labels (deltas with +/− sign, totals in bold)

deltaFormat.desc: Format code for delta labels; default = value format with an explicit +/− sign

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

valueAxis.desc: Show the value axis and gridlines (off by default: labels carry the numbers)

axisBreak.desc: false | 'auto' | {start, end, gap}: break the value axis between zero and the walk so small deltas stay readable

pctOfStart.desc: Tooltip shows each delta as % of the opening total

crossFilter.desc: Click a step to cross-filter / highlight on the label field (off by default: step names rarely key other datasets)

crossFilterScope.desc: Where a step click filters: 'dataset' (only blocks on this bridge's dataset — step names are generic) | 'global' (every dataset with the label field)

interactions: Hover tooltip with change, % of opening total and running total
Optional click-to-cross-filter on steps (crossFilter: true; scoped to this dataset)
Animated build-up of the walk; smooth transitions on filter change
